The '''Drall Patriot Warehouse''' was a bunker located on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was used by the [[Drall Patriots]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Drall Patriots don't seem to have any connections with the Chirq Council, though they were definitely hatching some future terrorist activities.|[[Lilith Laughlin]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" />}}
The Drall Patriot Warehouse was located on the outskirts of the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the warehouse was inhabited by a group of Drall Patriots,<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> an organization of [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] extremists fighting for the independence of [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] from the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Diktat|government]].<ref name="SWG:DPC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Drall Patriot's Cave|Corellia}}</ref>

[[File:Drall_Patriots.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Drall Patriots in the warehouse.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] agent working for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] investigated the warehouse because the informant [[Lilith Laughlin]] mentioned possible connections between the Drall Patriots and a criminal organization known as the [[Chirq Council]]. The agent assaulted the bunker and killed several Drall Patriot tacticians. Although it was discovered that the Patriots were hatching some future terrorist activities, no evidence of connections with the Chirq Council was found.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" />

In the meantime, the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] peacekeeper [[Dayana]] was also investigating the bunker. The Selonian was afraid that the Drall Patriots could be using the bunker to plan their future attack. She therefore recruited a spacer to infiltrate the warehouse and downloaded information from their data terminals in order to discover what they were planning. The spacer was successful and Dayana ensured that the information gathered would be crucial to prevent the Drall Patriots from harming innocent people.<ref name="SWG:GIotDP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Drall Patriot Warehouse appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Drall Patriot Warehouse was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
